scripts.title: auto farm - kills & credits
scripts.features:
This script will teleport all your alt accounts to your 'Main' where you can endless farm them. If this does well I'll make every way better and maybe even turn it into a project. 

[Beware Bugs] - I made this in 5 Minutes.
scripts.script:
getgenv().AutoFarm = true

local username = "PlantMeAStar" -- put the target username here

local function MainAccount()
    for i, v in pairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
        if v.Name == username then
            return v
        end
    end
    return nil 
end

local function TTM()
    local target = MainAccount()

    if not target then
        warn("Target player '" .. username .. "' not found in server.")
        return
    end
    if not target.Character then
        warn("Target player's character is not loaded yet.")
        return
    end

    local Players = game.Players.LocalPlayer

    if not Players.Character then return end

    local Target = target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not Target then return end

    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(
        0,
        Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,
        Enum.EasingDirection.Out,
        0,
        false,
        0
    )

    local tweenGoal = { CFrame = Target.CFrame }
    local tween = TweenService:Create(Players.Character.HumanoidRootPart, tweenInfo, tweenGoal)
    tween:Play()
end

while getgenv().AutoFarm do
    task.wait()
    TTM()
end
